mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) relative to the prior month's value signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 0.2 percentage points over a 3-month period signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precedes negative S&P 500 returns over the following 20 trading days due to reduced consumer spending and corporate profit expectations.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE rises by more than 0.2pp over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and GDP growth (GDPC1) over the prior 3 months signals a contraction in the real economy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced consumer and business investment.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 50% of instances where both HOUST and GDPC1 decline by at least 0.5% over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 194.0), a sustained increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeding 0.1 percentage points over the prior month signals monetary tightening, which typically causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to increased cost of capital for businesses.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 194.0 and FEDFUNDS rises by at least 0.1pp.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 0.5% over the prior month signals weakening manufacturing activity, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings growth expectations are revised downward.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO falls by more than 0.5% over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the prior 3 months signals growing consumer confidence and construction activity, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the real economy expands.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is negative in more than 50% of instances where HOUST increases by at least 0.5% over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 0.5% over the prior month signals accelerating inflation, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as the market reacts to the threat of tighter monetary policy.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is positive in more than 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL rises by more than 0.5% over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) exceeding 0.5% over the prior 3 months signals strengthening labor market conditions, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending and business investment are supported.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 50% of instances where PAYEMS increases by at least 0.5% over the prior 3 months.
